title: Zariski-Dense Monodromy of Singular Hyperbolic Metrics on Non-Hyperbolic Riemann Surfaces
summary: We prove that the monodromy group of every singular hyperbolic metric on a non-hyperbolic Riemann surface, in the sense of potential theory, is Zariski dense in ${\rm PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$, confirming a conjecture of the authors. The main new step is to show that a singular hyperbolic metric on an arbitrary parabolic Riemann surface cannot have monodromy contained in a conjugate of the real affine subgroup of ${\rm PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})$.
